house_rules.title: Charged is not guilty
house_rules.guidance: A defendant is charged, not guilty, unless convicted. Describe legal status precisely; never assert guilt for an unresolved case.

house_rules.title: Leak-sourced claims need corroboration
house_rules.guidance: Claims resting on leaked material require independent corroboration before publication.
